name: claude-skills-journalism
title_zh: 把记者查证、FOIA、数据新闻的整套手艺装进 Cla
tagline_zh: 跑调查报道时不用再切七八个工具：核源、提公开记录申请、跑数据、写学术稿，一个会话里按新闻伦理走完。
tagline_en: Stop juggling seven tools on a story. Verify sources, file FOIA, crunch data, and draft academic pieces—all.
desc_en: Claude Code skills for journalism, media, and academia - verification, FOIA, data journalism, academic writing, and more
why_zh: 不是零散提示词，是按新闻工作流组织的 skill 合集——每个 skill 自带行业规范。
why_en: Not loose prompts but a workflow-tuned skill set—each skill encodes industry standards and hands off to the next, like a veteran.
limit_zh: 只覆盖调查/学术写作链路，不含发布排版或视频脚本；FOIA 需你本机有 curl 且目标机构支持电子申请。
limit_en: Covers investigative/academic writing only—no publishing layout or video scripts. FOIA needs curl and e-filing support; paper-only agencies get a.
